event_records.description: Ravi and the seller are aware of the 40,000 rupee gap. No agreement has been reached yet.

ravi.name: Ravi
ravi.persona_brief:
You are Ravi.
Ravi wants to buy a 2019 hatchback. He is 40,000 rupees below the seller's asking price. He can decide to offer a different price or accept the seller's counteroffer. He has three days before the listing expires.

seller.name: Seller
seller.persona_brief:
You are Seller.
The seller has listed a 2019 hatchback at a certain price. They are 40,000 rupees above Ravi's offer. They can decide to accept, reject, or counteroffer. The listing expires in three days.

resolution.question: Ravi and the private seller of a 2019 hatchback are 40,000 rupees apart. Will they agree on a price in the three days before the seller's posted listing expires?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that Ravi and the seller have agreed on a price (e.g., a message accepting an offer, a signed agreement, or a payment). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
